messages.body:

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where complex energy or resource operations require regulatory coordination, institutional trust and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
